findings.excerpt: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, three wholesale distributors in the U.S.—McKesson Corporation, Cencora, Inc., and Cardinal Health, Inc.—each accounted for a significant percentage of our consolidated revenue. No other customer accounted for more than 10 percent of our consolidated revenue in any of these years.

note: 搜尋未取得逐字原文與三大批發商占營收確切百分比；未找到批發商信用評等惡化或LLY相關破產/降評/下修來源。FY2024 10-K 摘要稱 McKesson、Cencora、Cardinal 三家為重要客戶、其他客戶皆未超過10%。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
